pages.text: Start at the source. Put fuel and a capacitor in the Stirling Generator. Check for stored FE. On a photovoltaic array, check sky access, time, and any soul or fluid conditions.

For a direct connection, choose Push on the source face and Pull on the receiver face. Banks with blank faces allow external requests. Set a bank to Push or Push / Pull where it should send FE itself.

Check the capacitor slot of the receiving machine. Verify the route’s conduit endpoints and that no face is Disabled. Try a single working source and receiver using $(l:enderio:power/energy_transfer)Moving Energy$(/l).
